Meals and Nutrition

We aim to provide balanced, age-appropriate meals and snacks in a welcoming environment. Families should inform us of food allergies, dietary restrictions, medical needs, or cultural food preferences during enrollment.

Menus, meal participation, and food accommodations depend on the child’s age, enrollment agreement, allergy information, and applicable childcare requirements.

Parent Communication

Families may receive:

  • Daily progress updates
  • Meal and snack updates
  • Nap information
  • Diapering or potty-training updates
  • Activity highlights
  • Important reminders
  • Developmental observations
  • Incident notifications when applicable
